title: Two killed in 'massive' Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region, says Russia
english: A significant overnight Ukrainian drone attack on the Moscow region has resulted in the deaths of two people and injuries to several others. Russian officials reported that hundreds of drones were intercepted, though damage occurred to residential buildings, a warehouse, and an oil refinery. This escalation follows recent deadly Russian strikes on civilian areas in Ukraine, marking an intensification of cross-border hostilities.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሞስኮ አካባቢ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸውንና በርካቶች መቁሰላቸውን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት አስታወቁ። የሩሲያ መከላከያ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ድሮኖችን መትተው መጣላቸውን ቢገልጽም፣ ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችንና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ንብረቶች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ይህ ክስተት በዩክሬን በኩል የተፈጸሙ ገዳይ ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የጦርነት ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Yukireeniin naannoo Moskootti haleellaa oronii cimaa ta'e raawwattee kanaan namoonni lama lubbuun darbuu fi kaan ammoo miidhamuu isaanii qondaalonni Raashiyaa beeksisaniiru. Raashiyaan oronii dhibbaan lakkaa'aman rukutamanii kufuun isaanii ibsituus, haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa, bakka meeshaan itti kuufamu fi iddoo suphaa boba'aa irratti miidha geessiseera. Kunis, Yukireenitti haleellaa kanaan dura Raashiyaan raawwattee fi namoota ajjeeste booda, waldhabdeen biyyoota lamaanii hammaachaa dhufuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Journalists locked out of the White House after Trump ban
english: Donald Trump has prohibited reporters from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from entering the White House. These news organizations argue that the ban violates constitutional rights regarding freedom of the press. They believe the decision was made to punish them for their specific reporting on the administration.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሲ ኤን ኤን፣ የኤም ኤስ ኤን ቢ ሲ እና የፖሊቲኮ ጋዜጠኞች ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ እንዳይገቡ ከልክለዋል። እነዚህ የዜና ተቋማት ክልከላው የፕሬስ ነፃነትን የሚጥስና ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን የሚጋፋ ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። ውሳኔውም የተወሰደው በሪፖርታቸው ምክንያት በመሆኑ አድልዎ የተሞላበት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Donald Traamp gabaasotni CNN, MSNBC fi Politico gara mana mootummaa (White House) akka hin seenne dhorkeera. Dhaabbileen oduu kun tarkaanfiin kun mirga bilisummaa miidiyaa fi heera mootummaa kan cabsu akka ta'e dubbatu. Akka isaan jedhanitti, dhorkaan kun gabaasa isaan mootummaa irratti dhiyeessaniin walqabatee kan fudhatamee dha.

title: Two German states go to the polls after far-right gains
english: Voters in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania are heading to the polls amid significant political uncertainty for Chancellor Friedrich Merz. His leadership faces pressure following a recent defeat by the far-right AfD party and low public approval ratings regarding his reform efforts. These regional elections are seen as a critical test for his coalition government and his future as head of the Christian Democratic Union.
amharic: የጀርመን ዋና ከተማ በርሊን እና ሜክለንበርግ-ዌስተርን ፖሜራኒያ ነዋሪዎች በቻንስለር ፍሬድሪክ ሜርዝ የፖለቲካ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳርፍ በሚችል ምርጫ ላይ ድምጽ እየሰጡ ነው። የቻንስለሩ ፓርቲ በቅርቡ በከፍተኛ የቀኝ አክራሪ ቡድን ከተሸነፈ በኋላ እና በኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያ እቅዶቹ ላይ የህዝብ ድጋፍ በመቀነሱ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛል። እነዚህ ክልላዊ ምርጫዎች የሜርዝን የመሪነት ብቃት እና የጥምር መንግስታቸውን ጥንካሬ የሚፈትኑ ወሳኝ ክንውኖች ናቸው።
oromo: Filattoon mootummoota naannoo Berlin fi Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru, dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa Chaanselar Firedirih Merz irratti uumuu danda'a. Paartiin Chaanselarichaa kanaan dura garee mirga-durtuu AfD irraa injifatamuun isaa fi jijjiirama dinagdee irratti deggersi uummataa xiqqaachuun isaa mootummaa isaa qormaata keessa galcheera. Filattoon kun hoggansa Merz fi cimina mootummaa isaanii irratti qormaata guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Jammertest: Arctic exercise to counter satellite jamming
english: Military and technology firms are currently conducting annual drills in Norway known as Jammertest. These exercises focus on developing strategies to protect satellite communications from intentional signal interference. Such jamming poses a significant risk to critical infrastructure, including global transportation networks and financial systems.
amharic: የወታደራዊ እና የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች በኖርዌይ ውስጥ 'ጃመርተስት' በመባል የሚታወቀውን አመታዊ ልምምድ እያካሄዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ልምምዶች የሳተላይት ምልክቶችን ሆን ተብሎ ከመስተጓጎል ለመከላከል የሚያስችሉ ስልቶችን ለማዘጋጀት ያለመ ነው። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ጣልቃ ገብነት በአውሮፕላኖች፣ በመርከቦች እና በፋይናንስ ገበያዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ይደቅናል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen waraanaa fi teeknoolojii biyyoota addunyaa, biyya Noorweey keessatti 'Jammertest' kan jedhamuun beekamu shaakala waggaa gaggeessaa jiru. Shaakalichi mallattoowwan saateellayitii goobuu fi miidhuu irraa ittisuuf xiyyeeffata. Akkaataa kanaan mallattoowwan saateellayitii wal-qabsiisuun, akka xiyyaaraa fi doonii, akkasumas gabaa faayinaansii irratti miidhaa geessisuu danda'a.

title: State funeral honours Hong Kong’s first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa
english: Hong Kong held a rare state funeral for Tung Chee-hwa, the city's inaugural leader after the 1997 transition from British rule. The ceremony, attended by high-ranking officials from both Hong Kong and Beijing, honored the former shipping tycoon who passed away at 89. Tung led the region through significant challenges like the Asian financial crisis and the SARS outbreak before stepping down from his post in 2005.
amharic: ሆንግ ኮንግ ከብሪታንያ አስተዳደር በኋላ የመጀመሪያው መሪ ለነበሩት ለቱንግ ቺ-ህዋ ብርቅዬ የሆነ የመንግስት የቀብር ስነስርዓት አከናውናለች። በ89 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩት የቀድሞው የባህር ትራንስፖርት ባለሀብት የቀብር ስነስርዓት፣ ከሆንግ ኮንግ እና ቤጂንግ በተውጣጡ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ተገኝተዋል። ቱንግ በስልጣን ዘመናቸው እንደ እስያ የፋይናንስ ቀውስ እና የሳርስ ወረርሽኝ ያሉ ትላልቅ ፈተናዎችን በማለፍ በ2005 ስልጣናቸውን በገዛ ፈቃዳቸው መልቀቃቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Hong Kong geggeessaa ishee jalqabaa erga bittaa Biritishii booda turan Tung Chii-hwaaf sirna awwaalcha mootummaa kabaja qabu raawwatteetti. Umuriin isaanii waggaa 89tti kan boqotan, qabeenyaa fi daldalaan kan beekaman Tung, sirna awwaalcha isaanii irratti hoggantoonni olaanoo Hong Kong fi Beijing argamaniiru. Tung yeroo hojii isaanii keessatti rakkoolee cimaa akka kutaaleen ardii Eeshiyaa diinagdee isaanii miidhamuu fi dhibee SARS wajjin walqabatu akkasumas bara 2005 aangoo gadhiisuu isaanii dura hojiiwwan gurguddoo hojjechaa turan.

title: Tunisian protesters demand release of four Sumud activists
english: Protesters in Tunis marched to demand the immediate release of four activists from the Global Sumud Flotilla who have been detained since March on financial charges. The activists are currently on a hunger strike to protest their imprisonment, and supporters are expressing deep concern as their physical health continues to worsen. Demonstrators claim the government's legal actions against these individuals are politically motivated and represent an effort to suppress civil society.
amharic: በቱኒዚያ ዋና ከተማ ታוניስ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች ከሰባት ወራት በፊት በፋይናንሺያል ክስ የታሰሩ የአራት የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች በአስቸኳይ እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል። እስረኞቹ በእስር ቤቱ የሚደርስባቸውን በደል በመቃወም የስራ ማቆም አድማ እያደረጉ ሲሆን የጤንነት ሁኔታቸውም አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ እነዚህን ሰዎች ማሰር መንግስት የተቃውሞ ድምጾችን ለማፈን የሚጠቀምበት ስልት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mormitootni magaalaa Tunis keessatti argaman, aktivistoota garee 'Global Sumud Flotilla' kan ji'a Bitootessaa irraa eegalee himannaa faayinaansii irratti banamee hidhamanii jiran afur akka gadhiifaman gaafachaa jiru. Aktivistootni kunneen hidhamuu isaanii mormuun waggaa tokkoof nyaata dhaabuun erga eegalanii booda fayyaan isaanii baay'ee gad ta'uun isaa sodaa guddaa uumeera. Namootni hiriira ba'an kunneen, hidhaan kun yaada mormituu fi siviilii hawaasaa ukkaamsuuf kan karoorfamee ta'uu isaa dubbatu.

title: Two Palestinian men injured in West Bank settler attack
english: Two Palestinian men were wounded during an assault by Israeli settlers near the West Bank town of Salfit on Sunday. One victim suffered a head injury from a thrown rock, while the other was stabbed in the leg. Medical teams provided emergency care before transporting both individuals to a local hospital for further treatment.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በምዕራብ ባንክ ሳልፊት ከተማ አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። አንደኛው ግለሰብ በድንጋይ በመመታቱ የጭንቅላት ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሲሆን ሁለተኛው ደግሞ በጭኑ በቢላ ተወግቷል። የፍልስጤም ቀይ ጨረቃ አምቡላንስ ቡድን ለተጎጂዎቹ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ህክምና ካደረገላቸው በኋላ ወደ ሆስፒታል ወስዷቸዋል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe naannoo magaalaa Salfiititti namoonni Falasxiin lama haleellaa warra Israa'el qe'ee qabatan irra gaheen miidhamaniiru. Namoota kanneen keessaa tokko dhagaan mataa isaa rukutamee miidhameera, inni biraan immoo gadii irra waraaneera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa Falasxiin miidhamtoota kana yaalii jalqabaa taasifanii gara hospitaalaatti geessaniiru.

title: Trump cuts short weekend at Camp David, returns to White House
english: President Donald Trump unexpectedly returned to the White House from Camp David a day earlier than planned this weekend. While the administration did not provide an official reason, the move coincides with heightened tensions in the Middle East following a missile attack on Riyadh by Houthi rebels. Officials have also issued security warnings to U.S. citizens abroad regarding the potential for further regional instability.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከታቀደው ጊዜ ቀድመው ከካምፕ ዴቪድ በድንገት ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ ተመልሰዋል። መንግስት ለዚህ ውሳኔ ኦፊሴላዊ ምክንያት ባይሰጥም፣ ይህ ክስተት የሁቲ አማፂያን በሪያድ ላይ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ማድረሳቸውን ተከትሎ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በተፈጠረው ውጥረት ወቅት የተከሰተ ነው። በተጨማሪም፣ በአካባቢው ሊከሰት የሚችለውን አለመረጋጋት በመስጋት ለአሜሪካውያን የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp karoorfamee ture irra guyyaa tokko dursanii lafa boqonnaa isaanii Kaamp Deevidii irraa gara mana mootummaa (White House) deebi'aniiru. Mootummaan sababa isaa ifatti baasee hin ibsine; ta'us, tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga gareen Huutii Riyaaditti xiyyaara waraanaa ergee booda naannicha keessatti jeequmsi dabaluu isaa wajjin wal qabata. Kana malees, lammiileen Ameerikaa naannicha jiran akka of eeggannoo godhan akeekkachiisni tasgabbii dabarfameera.

title: West Bank families led by women face greater displacement risks, OCHA says
english: A UN report indicates that households led by women in the West Bank are at a higher risk of displacement due to increasing violence from Israeli settlers. These families also struggle more with chronic health issues and face significant obstacles in travel and employment due to movement restrictions. Despite these challenges, these women continue to carry the primary responsibility for managing finances, childcare, and their families' overall safety.

Maatiiwwan kun rakkoolee fayyaa fi daangaa sochiin walqabatuun jireenya isaanii jiraachuuf baay'ee rakkatu. Rakkoo kana hunda keessa illee, dubartoonni kun itti gaafatamummaa maatii bulchuu, ijoollee guddifachuu fi nageenya maatii isaanii eeguu qofa isaanii baachaa jiru.

title: Israeli strikes target Lebanon's Nabatieh, ambulance team
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted multiple airstrikes across southern Lebanon, specifically targeting the city of Nabatieh and the Bint Jbeil district. During the operation, an ambulance crew providing emergency aid was also struck. These attacks resulted in significant property damage, including the destruction of a residential building.

title: WEGAGEN SWELLS BALANCE SHEET, PROMISES
english: The Ethiopian Parliament has officially approved a new cabinet consisting of 22 ministers. Notably, this appointment includes three leaders from opposition parties. While the motion passed successfully, two members of parliament voted against it and 12 chose to abstain.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፓርላማ አዲስ የተሾሙ 22 ሚኒስትሮችን በይፋ አጽድቋል። በዚህ የሹመት ዝርዝር ውስጥ ከሶስት የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ አመራሮች የተውጣጡ አባላት መካተታቸው ታውቋል። አዲሱ የካቢኔ አወቃቀር በፓርላማው ቢጸድቅም፣ ሁለት አባላት ተቃውሞ የገጠሙ ሲሆን 12ቱ ደግሞ ድምጸ ተዓቅቦ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Parlamaan Itoophiyaa ministiroota haaraa 22 ta'an ifatti raggaasee jira. Muudama kana keessatti hogganoonni paartilee mormituu sadii ta'an kan hammataman yoo ta'u, kunis jijjiirama siyaasaa iddoo guddaa qabuudha. Murtichi yoo raggaasifameyyuu, miseensonni mana marichaa lama mormii isaanii ibsatanii, 12 immoo sagalee kennuu irraa of qusataniiru.

title: The Leather Trade Rots Be-tween Slaughter, Factory
english: Despite Ethiopia possessing one of the largest cattle populations in the world, its leather industry is currently declining. A significant amount of potential value is wasted because hides and skins often spoil during the transition from slaughterhouses to processing factories. This inefficiency negatively impacts the livelihoods of collectors and limits the overall success of the leather sector.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ከሚሊዮን በላይ የከብቶች ሀብት ቢኖራትም የቆዳና ሌጦ ኢንዱስትሪዋ ግን እያሽቆለቆለ ይገኛል። ከእርድ ቦታዎች ወደ ፋብሪካዎች በሚደረግ የትራንስፖርት እና አያያዝ ሂደት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የቆዳ ምርት በመበላሸቱ ሀገሪቱ ተጠቃሚ መሆን አልቻለችም። ይህ የዘርፉ ድክመት በቆዳ ሰብሳቢዎች ኑሮ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan qabeenya loonii baay'ee kan qabdu ta'us, industiriin gogaa biyyattii amma gadi bu'aa jira. Gogaan qulqulluun qaleettii irraa gara maashinota gogaa qopheessaniitti yeroo geeffamu balali'uun gatii isaa dhabuun isaa industiricha miidheera. Rakkoon kun jireenya namoota gogaa sassaabanii irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jira.

title: Grid Power Reaches Kurmuk Goldmine as Allied Gold Regroups
english: The Canadian mining firm Allied Gold has successfully linked its Kurmuk gold project in Ethiopia to the national power grid. By utilizing an 88-kilometer transmission line, the company has started processing ore at the site. This development brings the project close to producing its first gold, though commercial operations have not yet officially commenced.
amharic: የካናዳው የማዕድን ኩባንያ አላይድ ጎልድ በኢትዮጵያ የሚገኘውን የኩርሙክ ወርቅ ማዕድን ማውጫ ከሀገራዊ የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል መረብ ጋር ማገናኘቱን አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው በ88 ኪሎ ሜትር የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር አማካኝነት ማዕድኑን መፍጨት የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለወርቅ ምርት ዝግጅቱ ትልቅ እርምጃ ሆኗል። ምንም እንኳን የመጀመሪያው የወርቅ ምርት በቅርቡ እንደሚጠበቅ ቢገለጽም፣ ኩባንያው እስካሁን የንግድ ምርት መጀመሩን አላረጋገጠም።
oromo: Dhaabbanni qonna albuudaa kan Kaanaadaa, Allied Gold, pirojektii warqee Kurmuk kan Itoophiyaa keessa jiru gara marsaarii elektirikii biyyoolessaatti milkaa'inaan goggooseera. Sarsara elektirikii kiilomeetira 88 dheeratu fayyadamuun, dhaabbattichi albuuda naquu fi daakudhaan hojii eegaleera. Kunis pirojektichi warqee jalqabaa akka argatu gargaara, ta'us hojiin gurgurtaa inni gurguddaan ammatti hin eegalle.

title: Central Bank Bars Banks from Paying Deposit Interest Up-front
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia has issued an immediate ban on banks paying interest on deposits before the agreed-upon maturity period ends. This directive prevents financial institutions from crediting interest upfront or adding it to the principal balance prematurely. The move follows regulatory findings that some banks were improperly advancing interest payments before the required holding time was met.

title: T-Bill Yields Slide to a Record Low as Banks Return to Lending
english: The Ethiopian government is now borrowing money at a record-low interest rate, with the 28-day Treasury bill yield falling to 3.1 percent. Despite lower overall investment bids, the government successfully accepted a significantly higher portion of the offers compared to recent auctions. This trend highlights a growing gap between the government's borrowing costs and the interest rates found in the broader money market.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በአጭር ጊዜ የገንዘብ ግምጃ ቤት ሰነዶች ላይ የሚያወጣው የወለድ መጠን ወደ 3.1 በመቶ በመውረድ በታሪክ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። ምንም እንኳን ለጨረታው የቀረበው የኢንቨስትመንት መጠን የቀነሰ ቢሆንም፣ መንግስት ከቀደምት ጨረታዎች በበለጠ የገንዘብ ጥያቄዎችን ተቀብሏል። ይህ ሁኔታ የመንግስት የመበደር አቅምና በሌሎች የገንዘብ ገበያዎች ላይ ካለው የወለድ መጠን መካከል ትልቅ ልዩነት መፈጠሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa liqii isaa baasii gadi aanaa ta'een argachaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, bu'aan gurgurtaa boondii guyyaa 28f qophaa'e gara dhibbeentaa 3.1tti gadi bu'eera. Walumaagalatti kutaaleen investimantii hir'atanis, mootummaan kanneen kanaan duraa wajjin yoo madaalamu dhibbeentaa guddaa fudhachuun isaa ibsameera. Haalli kun baasii liqii mootummaa fi gatii qalamaa gabaa keessa jiru gidduutti garagarummaan bal'aan akka uumame agarsiisa.

title: Ed Sheeran addresses Macklemore controversy at Philadelphia show
english: Ed Sheeran recently addressed the controversy surrounding the removal of rapper Macklemore from his tour due to comments about the Israel-Palestine conflict. During a show in Philadelphia, Sheeran clarified that he did not personally make the decision to drop the artist and expressed his desire for his concerts to remain spaces of unity rather than political division. He also shared his personal views on the ongoing humanitarian crisis, condemning the violence occurring in both Israel and Gaza while emphasizing his commitment to his fans.
amharic: ኤድ ሺራን በእስራኤል እና ፍልስጤም ግጭት ላይ በሰጡት አስተያየት ምክንያት ማክልሞር ከጉብኝቱ ስለመባረሩ በተፈጠረው ውዝግብ ዙሪያ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሀሳባቸውን ሰጥተዋል። በፊላደልፊያ በተካሄደው ኮንሰርት ላይ የዘፋኙን ስም ከዝርዝር ውስጥ የማውጣት ውሳኔ የእሳቸው እንዳልሆነ የገለጹት ሺራን፣ ኮንሰርቶቻቸው የፖለቲካ መድረክ ሳይሆኑ የሰላም እና የአንድነት ቦታ እንዲሆኑ እንደሚፈልጉ አስረድተዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜም በጋዛ እና በእስራኤል እየደረሰ ያለውን ሰብአዊ ቀውስ በማውገዝ ለተጎጂዎች ያላቸውን አዘኔታ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ed Sheeran, waraana Israa'el fi Falasxiin irratti yaada inni kenneen wal qabatee rapparaa Macklemore daawwii isaa irraa ari'amuun isaa mormii guddaa uumee ture. Sheeran, garaa garummaa siyaasaa irra walitti dhufeenya fi tasgabbii kan dursu ta'uu isaa ibsuun, murtoon Macklemore ari'uuf kenname kan isaa akka hin taane ifa godhe. Philadelphia irratti ergaa dabarseen, rakkoo namoomaa naannichatti mudate balaaleffachuun, waraanni fi miidhaan namoota nagaa irratti gahaa jiru baay'ee akka isa gaddisiise ibseera.

title: DR Congo rolls out Ebola vaccine for health workers as death toll rises
english: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have started vaccinating 50,000 frontline workers against Ebola in the Ituri and North Kivu provinces. While the current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, officials are administering the Ervebo vaccine in hopes that it provides some protection. A long-term clinical trial will monitor 20,000 of these recipients to determine the effectiveness of this vaccine against the latest virus variant.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የጤና ባለስልጣናት በኢቱሪ እና በሰሜን ኪቩ ግዛቶች በኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ግንባር ቀደም ሆነው ለሚሰሩ 50,000 የጤና ባለሙያዎች የክትባት ዘመቻ ጀምረዋል። አሁን ያለው የወረርሽኙ አይነት ቡንዲቡግዮ ቢሆንም፣ ባለስልጣናት ኤርቬቦ የተባለውን ክትባት በመጠቀም የተወሰነ ጥበቃ ለማግኘት እየሞከሩ ነው። ይህ ክትባት አሁን ላለው የኢቦላ አይነት ምን ያህል ውጤታማ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ 20,000 የሚሆኑ ክትባቱን የወሰዱ ሰዎች ለአንድ አመት ክትትል ይደረግባቸዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa fayyaa biyya Koongoo, naannolee Iturii fi Kaaba Kivu keessatti hojjettoota fayyaa 50,000 ta'anif talaallii Iboolaa kennuu jalqabaniiru. Dhibeen ammaa kun vaayrasii 'Bundibugyo' jedhamuun kan ka'e yoo ta'u, qorattoonni garuu talaallii 'Ervebo' jedhamuun ittisa barbaacha jiratu. Talaalliin kun vaayrasicha ammaa kana irratti hanga maaliitti akka gargaaru beekuuf, namoota 20,000 ta'an irratti waggaa tokkoof hordoffii taasisuuf karoorfameera.

title: Iran war live: Tehran sets terms for peace; Saudi forces foil Riyadh attack
english: Iran has officially submitted its requirements for ending the ongoing conflict to the United States through Qatari intermediaries. Key demands from Tehran include a total ceasefire across all battlefronts, the restoration of access to restricted Iranian financial assets, and the removal of the American naval blockade on its ports. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabian defense forces reported that they successfully intercepted an attack targeting Riyadh.
amharic: ኢራን በኳታር አደራዳሪዎች በኩል ጦርነቱን ለማቆም የሚያስፈልጓትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ለአሜሪካ ማቅረቧን አስታውቃለች። የቴህራን ዋና ዋና ጥያቄዎች በሁሉም ግንባሮች ጦርነቱ እንዲቆም፣ የታገዱ የሀገሪቱ የገንዘብ ሀብቶች እንዲለቀቁ እና በአሜሪካ የተጣለው የባህር ላይ እገዳ እንዲነሳ ያካትታሉ። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ የሳውዲ አረቢያ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በሪያድ ላይ የተሰነዘረ ጥቃትን ማክሸፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Iraan waraana kana xumuruuf haala barbaaddu giddu-galeessa Kaataar fayyadamtee mootummaa Ameerikaatti beeksisiteetti. Gaaffileen Tehraan keessaa ijoon, waraanni guutummaatti akka dhaabbatu, qabeenyi biyyattii qabbanaa'ee ture akka gadhiifamu fi Ameerikaan markaboota ishee irratti dhorkaa kaa'e akka kaasuu dha. Gamasa biraatin, humnoonni nageenyaa Sa'udii Arabaa magaalaa Riyaadi irratti karoorfame ture fashaleessuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Turkiye backs Saudi Arabia’s security amid escalating Houthi attacks: FM
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has expressed his country's commitment to supporting Saudi Arabia’s security following intensified attacks from Houthi rebels in Yemen. This support is framed within the recently established Mecca Defence Alliance, which also includes Pakistan and dictates that an attack on one member is considered an attack on all. While Turkiye and Pakistan have pledged to assist, they are currently working to prevent the kingdom from being drawn into a broader regional conflict.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሀካን ፊዳን በየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን እየደረሰ ያለውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የሳውዲ አረቢያን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሀገራቸው ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ድጋፍ በቅርቡ በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል በተፈረመው የመካ የመከላከያ ህብረት ስምምነት መሰረት የሚከናወን ሲሆን፣ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ ይቆጠራል። ምንም እንኳን ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ ቃል ቢገቡም፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ወደ ሰፊ የክልል ግጭት እንዳትገባ ለመከላከል እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Turkii Hakaan Fidaan, weerara finxaaleyyii Huutii Yemen irraa ka’uun Sa’udii Arabiyaatti xiyyeeffachaa jiru ilaalchisee, nageenya biyyattii kabachiisuuf Turkiin deeggarsa gochuuf qophiidha jedhan. Deeggarsi kun kan hundaa’e gamtaa ittisaa 'Mecca Defence Alliance' jedhamu kan Turkii, Sa’udii fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame irratti yoo ta’u, biyyoota kanneen keessaa tokko irratti miidhaan yoo ga’e, hunda isaanii akka miidhetti akka ilaalamu ibsa. Turkiin fi Paakistaan deeggarsa gochuuf waadaa seenus, Sa’udii Arabiyaan waraana naannichaa bal’aa keessatti akka hin hirmaanne ittisuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: West Bank: Eight Palestinians detained, settlers damage ambulance
english: Israeli forces arrested eight Palestinians in the West Bank following an attempted livestock theft and settler confrontation. In separate incidents, settlers damaged local infrastructure, destroyed crops, and assaulted residents and activists. Additionally, an ambulance was vandalized while attempting to provide medical aid to Palestinians attacked with pepper spray.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በከብት መስረቅ ሙከራ እና በተቀሰቀሰ ግጭት ሳቢያ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በሌሎች አካባቢዎችም ሰፋሪዎች የመሠረተ ልማት አውታሮችን በማውደም፣ ሰብሎችን በመቁረጥ እና በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በበርበሬ መረቅ ለተጠቁ ሰዎች የሕክምና እርዳታ ለመስጠት ሲሄድ የነበረ አምቡላንስ በሰፋሪዎች ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Godina wixxee Baankii keessatti waraanni Israa'el qabeenya mancaasuu fi walitti bu'iinsa uumameen walqabatee namoota Falasxiin saddeet hidhaatti guureera. Gochaa adda addaa biraatiinis, qubattoonni lafa sanaa bu'uraalee misoomaa mancaasuun, mukkeen muduraa muruun akkasumas jiraattotaa fi namoota deggarsa godhan irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Kana malees, namoota shubbisa qullubbii diimaatiin miidhaman gargaaruuf kan imalaa ture ambulaansiin tokko qubattootaan manca'eera.

title: Former Syrian general who led attacks on rebels during civil war arrested
english: Syrian authorities have apprehended Ahmed Mohammad Ismail, a former high-ranking Major General in the Republican Guard who served under Bashar al-Assad's administration. He is accused of directing military offensives against opposition-held territories, including Aleppo, Daraa, and Eastern Ghouta, throughout the country's long-running civil war. These operations involved significant violence, including a widely condemned 2013 chemical attack near Damascus.
amharic: የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞውን የሪፐብሊካን ጋርድ ከፍተኛ የጦር አዛዥ ሜጀር ጀነራል አህመድ መሐመድ እስማኤልን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ግለሰቡ በአገሪቱ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት በአሌፖ፣ በዳራ እና በምስራቅ ጉታ አካባቢዎች በተካሄዱ ጥቃቶች ላይ ቀጥተኛ ተሳትፎ እንደነበራቸው ይነገራል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች እ.ኤ.አ. በ2013 በደማስቆ አቅራቢያ ከተፈጸመው ገዳይ የኬሚካል ጥቃት ጋር የተያያዙ ሲሆን፣ አሁን በእርሳቸው ላይ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa ajajaan garee eegumsa biyyaa kan duraanii, Mejer Jeneraal Ahmed Mohaammad Ismaa'il, akka hidhamu taasisaniiru. Namni kun waraana Suuriyaa keessatti bakkeewwan mormitootni to'atanii turan kanneen akka Aleppo, Daraa fi Guta Bahaa irratti haleellaa geggeessaa akka ture himameera. Haleellaa kana keessatti bara 2013 magaalaa Damaasqoos biratti gaazii summiitiin namoota hedduu ajjeesuu dabalatee yakka waraanaa raawwachuu isaatiin shakkamee qabameera.

title: Turkish foreign minister says new proposals sent to US, Iran to end war
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan announced that Turkey is leading international efforts to mediate a resolution to the conflict between the United States and Iran. Despite previous failed attempts at agreements, new proposals have been shared to help both nations bridge their deep mutual distrust. Both parties are now cautiously exploring these options to ensure their individual national interests are protected.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሃካን ፊዳን እንደገለጹት፣ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ግጭት ለመፍታት ቱርክ ከአለም አቀፍ አጋሮች ጋር በመሆን አዳዲስ የሰላም ሀሳቦችን እያቀረበች ነው። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ስምምነቶች ባለመሳካታቸው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ከፍተኛ አለመተማመን ቢኖርም፣ አሁን እየቀረቡ ባሉት አዳዲስ ሀሳቦች ላይ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ፍላጎታቸውን ለማስጠበቅ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Turkii Hakan Fidan akka ibsetti, Turkii fi biyyoonni biroon walitti bu'insa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru furuuf yaada haaraa dhiyeessaa jiru. Kanaan dura yaaliin ta'e milkaa'uu baatus, amantii dhabuun jiru akka fooyya'uuf yaalii ta'aa jiru. Gareewwan lamaanuu faayidaa isaanii tikfachuuf jecha yaada haaraa kana irratti xiyyeeffannoodhaan mari'achaa jiru.

title: 'Middle East situation could escalate rapidly': US urges citizens to exercise caution
english: The US government has issued travel alerts for several Middle Eastern countries, warning citizens to remain vigilant due to the risk of sudden regional conflict escalation. Americans are advised to prepare for potential travel disruptions, including flight cancellations and closed airspace. Additionally, officials suggest avoiding large crowds and monitoring local news, as US interests in the region may be targeted by hostile groups.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ ዜጎቹ በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ በማንኛውም ጊዜ ሊባባስ ስለሚችል ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አስጠንቅቋል። ዜጎች የበረራ መሰረዝን ወይም የአየር ክልል መዘጋትን ጨምሮ ሊያጋጥሙ የሚችሉ የጉዞ መስተጓጎሎችን እንዲጠባበቁ ተመክሯል። እንዲሁም በአሜሪካ ጥቅሞች ላይ ጥቃት ሊሰነዘር ስለሚችል ሰዎች ከሰልፎች እና ከተጨናነቁ ቦታዎች እንዲርቁ እና የአካባቢውን ሁኔታ በየጊዜው እንዲከታተሉ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa lammiileen isaa biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaa keessa jiran haalli nageenyaa yeroodha gara yerootti waan jabaachuu danda'uuf of eeggannoo cimaa akka taasisan akeekkachiiseera. Namoonni kun balalliiwwan haquu fi cufiinsa sarara qilleensaa dabalatee rakkoolee geejjibaa mudachuu danda'an akka hubatan gorfamaniiru. Kana malees, faayidaan Ameerikaa bakkeewwan kanatti miidhamuu waan danda'uuf, lammiileen hiriiraa fi bakkeewwan namoonni baay'inaan itti wal ga'an irraa akka fagaatanii fi haala naannawaa isaanii hordofan hubachiiseera.

title: No US message expected during Pakistani minister’s visit, Tehran says
english: Pakistan's interior minister, Mohsin Naqvi, is visiting Tehran to discuss bilateral cooperation with Iranian officials. Iranian authorities have clarified that this meeting is not intended to facilitate any mediation between Iran and the United States. The primary goal of the visit is to review and advance existing agreements between the two neighboring nations.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሞህሲን ናቅቪ ከኢራን ባለስልጣናት ጋር ለመወያየት ወደ ቴህራን ጉዞ ያደርጋሉ። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህ ጉብኝት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል የሚደረግ የሽምግልና ጥረት እንዳልሆነ አስታውቀዋል። የጉብኝቱ ዋና ዓላማ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ስምምነቶችን ለመከታተል እና ለማጠናከር ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma keessa biyya Paakistaan Mohsin Naqvi haasawa qaamolee mootummaa Iraan waliin taasisuuf gara Teheran imaluuf qophaa’aa jira. Mootummaan Iraan akka ibsetti, imalli kun marii ykn giddu-galeessummaa biyyoota Iraaniifi Ameerikaa gidduutti taasifamu kan hin qabne dha. Kaayyoon ijoon imala kanaas waliigaltee kanaan dura biyyoota lamaan gidduutti taasifame irratti hordoffii gochuudha.

title: Our head teacher was an abuser. We joined forces to get justice - now we're married
english: Two former Indonesian boarding school students, Yusron and Zia, joined forces to expose their head teacher for sexually abusing multiple pupils. Despite the teacher’s attempts to silence them through intimidation, the pair recorded incriminating evidence and pursued justice together. Their shared experience of seeking truth eventually led to a strong personal bond, and the two are now married.
amharic: ሁለት የቀድሞ የኢንዶኔዢያ ተማሪዎች የሆኑት ዩስሮን እና ዚያ፣ የትምህርት ቤታቸው ርዕሰ መምህር በበርካታ ተማሪዎች ላይ የፈጸመውን የጾታዊ ጥቃት ለማጋለጥ ተባብረዋል። መምህሩ በተለያዩ ዛቻዎች ድርጊቱን እንዲደብቁ ቢሞክርም፣ ጥንዶቹ ማስረጃዎችን በመቅረጽ ለፍትህ ታግለዋል። ይህንን የጋራ ትግል በመቀናጀትም የጠበቀ ግንኙነት መስርተው በመጨረሻም በትዳር ተሳስረዋል።
oromo: Barattoonni duraanii manneen barnoota Islaamummaa kan ta'an Yusron fi Zia, barsiisaan isaanii ijoollee irratti miidhaa saala akka raawwate qorachuun himachuuf wal ta'an. Barsiisichi iccitiin isaa akka hin bahiniif sodaachisuuf yaaleus, lamaan isaanii ragaa walitti qabachuun haqaa argachuuf socho'an. Gamtaan dhugaa barbaaduu isaanii gara wal jaalachuutti geessee, yeroo ammaa gaa'ela dhaabbachuun waliin jiraatu.

title: Saudi-led coalition says defences intercept Houthi missile fired at Riyadh
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted a ballistic missile fired by Houthi rebels toward Riyadh. While the Houthis claimed to have targeted sensitive sites across several Saudi cities using drones and missiles, authorities reported no casualties or significant damage. This incident marks the first air raid alert in the Saudi capital since tensions between the two sides escalated earlier this year.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን ወደ ሪያድ ከተማ የተተኮሰ የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤል በአየር መከላከያ ስርዓቱ መትቶ ጥሏል። ሁቲዎች በሳውዲ የተለያዩ ከተሞች ላይ በድሮንና በሚሳኤል ጥቃት እንደፈጸሙ ቢናገሩም፣ ሳውዲ በበኩሏ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ወይም ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ግጭቱ ከተባባሰ በኋላ በሪያድ ሲሰማ የመጀመሪያው የአየር ጥቃት ማስጠንቀቂያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Mootummoota gamtoomaniin dura-bu'insa Sa'udii jiru, misha'eelii warra Huutii Yaman irraa gara Riyaaditti darbatame qilleensa irratti gubee balleessuun isaa beekameera. Warri Huutii magaaloota Sa'udii garagaraa irratti miishilootaafi xiyyaara nama hin feene (drones) fayyadamuun miidhaa gahuu isaanii ibsatanis, mootummaan Sa'udii garuu miidhaan lubbuu ykn qabeenyaa akka hin geenye beeksiseera. Kunis, waldhabdeen lamaan gidduutti uumame erga hammaatee as, Riyaad keessatti akeekkachiisni weerara qilleensaa yeroo jalqabaaf yeroo dhagahamuudha.

title: Fulham vs Manchester United: Premier League – prediction, teams, lineups
english: Manchester United faces significant pressure as they head to Craven Cottage to play Fulham this Sunday following a difficult start to the season. Manager Michael Carrick is under scrutiny after the team struggled with recent losses and a disappointing exit from the League Cup. Meanwhile, Fulham is also looking for their first league win of the campaign under new leadership.
amharic: ማንችስተር ዩናይትድ በውድድር ዘመኑ መጀመሪያ ላይ ባሳየው ደካማ አቋም ምክንያት በዚህ እሁድ ከፉልሃም ጋር በሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ ትልቅ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። አሰልጣኝ ማይክል ካሪክ በቅርብ ጊዜ በተከታታይ ሽንፈቶች እና ከሊግ ካፕ ውድድር በመሰናበታቸው በከፍተኛ ትችት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። በሌላ በኩል ፉልሃም በአዲሱ አሰልጣኙ መሪነት የሊጉን የመጀመሪያ ድል ለማግኘት እየጣረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Maanchistar Yuunaayitid jalqaba seexana kanaa taphachaa jiruun bu'aa gaarii dhabuu isaatiin walqabatee, Dilbata dhufu kana Fulham waliin taphachuuf yeroo qophaa'aa jiranitti dhiibbaa cimaa keessa jiru. Leenjisaan garee kanaa Maayikil Kaarik qormaata hedduu keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, kunis tapha kanaan duraa irratti kufaatii fi milkaa'ina dhabuu garee isaatiin kan dhufedha. Gama biraatiin, Fulham leenjisaa haaraa isaanii jalatti hanga ammaa injifannoo liigii tokkollee argachuu hin dandeenye, kanaafis tapha kana injifachuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Hegseth kicks off ‘Send Me Tour’ amid Iran war backlash
english: US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth has launched a domestic outreach initiative called the 'Send Me Tour' starting in Texas. This campaign aims to engage the public, though it coincides with a significant decline in his popularity. His public approval ratings have dropped to a record low of -24 points, largely driven by widespread dissatisfaction regarding the ongoing war with Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴት በቴክሳስ የጀመረውን 'ሴንድ ሚ ቱር' የተሰኘ አገር አቀፍ የጉብኝት መርሃ ግብር ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የህዝብ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት የታለመ ቢሆንም፣ የሚኒስትሩ ተወዳጅነት ግን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ማሽቆልቆሉን ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። አሁን ባለው የኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት በተፈጠረው የህዝብ ቅሬታ የተነሳ የሄግሴት ተቀባይነት ወደ -24 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል።
oromo: Ministirri Ittisa Ameerikaa Piit Hegeeseet magaalaa Teeksaas irraa jalqabee 'Send Me Tour' kan jedhamu duula beeksisuu jalqabeera. Duulli kun deeggarsa uummataa argachuuf kan qophaaye ta'us, yeroo kanatti jaalatamummaan isaa baay'ee gadi bu'ee jira. Sababa waraana Iiraan waliin jiruun uummata biratti mufannaan guddaan waan jiruuf, qabxiin fudhatama ministirichaa gara -24tti gadi bu'eera.

title: Denmark says ‘binding’ US deal on Greenland won’t compromise sovereignty
english: Denmark and Greenland have reached a security agreement with the United States to prevent Russian and Chinese military presence in the Arctic. While the deal grants the U.S. permanent security control over the territory, officials insist that Greenland's sovereignty remains protected. This agreement is expected to be formally signed at the United Nations to bolster NATO security, though some local residents remain cautious about the increased U.S. influence.
amharic: ዴንማርክ እና ግሪንላንድ በአርክቲክ ክልል የሩሲያ እና የቻይናን ወታደራዊ ተፅእኖ ለመከላከል ከአሜሪካ ጋር ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ስምምነቱ አሜሪካ በክልሉ ላይ ዘላቂ የፀጥታ ቁጥጥር እንድታደርግ ቢፈቅድም፣ የግሪንላንድ ሉዓላዊነት እንደማይነካ ባለስልጣናት አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የኔቶን የጋራ ደህንነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ሲሆን በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጉባኤ ላይ በይፋ እንደሚፈረም ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Deenmaark fi Giriinlaandiin naannoo Arktikitti dhiibbaa waraana Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaa ittisuuf Ameerikaa waliin walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Walii galteen kun Ameerikaan naannicharratti to'annoo nageenyaa dhaabbataa akka qabaattu kan hayyamu yoo ta'u, mootummoonni biyyoota lamaanii garuu mirgi abbaa biyyummaa Giriinlaand akka hin tuqamne ibsaniiru. Walii galteen kun nageenya Naatoo cimsuuf kan karoorfame yoo ta'u, torban dhufu Walgahii Gamtaa Mootummootaa irratti mallatta'a jedhamee eegama.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi capital after smoke seen rising near Riyadh airport
english: Yemeni Houthi militants launched a series of drone and missile strikes against Riyadh and Saudi energy facilities, causing visible damage near the international airport. The group claimed these attacks were retaliatory measures against recent Saudi military actions in Yemen. This escalation has caused flight disruptions in the Saudi capital and underscores the intensifying civil war conflict between the two sides.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሪያድ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያዎች ላይ በድሮን እና በረዥም ርቀት ሚሳኤሎች ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በሳውዲ አረቢያ ለሚመራው ጥምረት አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ ታጣቂዎቹ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በሪያድ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ መስተጓጎልን የፈጠረ ሲሆን በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭት ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Magaalota Yaman keessatti kan socho'an loltoonni Huutii, magaalaa Riyaadii fi buufataalee boba'aa Sa'udii irratti weerara xiyyaara maleeyyuu (dronii) fi misaa'elii geggeessaniiru. Gareen kun akka ibsetti, weerarri kun kan geggeeffame tarkaanfii waraana Sa'udiin Yaman irratti fudhatteef haaloo ba'uuf dha. Gochi kun buufata xiyyaaraa Riyaadii keessatti qophiiwwan xiyyaaraa akka gufatan taasiseera; akkasumas walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lameenii gidduu jiru hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets
english: President Donald Trump has barred reporters from CNN, Politico, and MSNBC from entering the White House, claiming these outlets spread false information. Security officers confiscated the identification badges of journalists from these organizations, preventing them from accessing the grounds. Media leaders and freedom of the press advocates have condemned the move as an unconstitutional violation of their rights.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሲ ኤን ኤን፣ የፖለቲኮ እና የኤም ኤስ ኤን ቢ ሲ ጋዜጠኞች የዋይት ሀውስ መግቢያ እንዳይፈቀድላቸው አግደዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ እነዚህ የዜና ተቋማት ሀሰተኛ መረጃዎችን እንደሚያሰራጩ በመግለጽ የጋዜጠኞቹን የመታወቂያ ካርዶች አስነጥቀዋል። የዜና ተቋማቱ አመራሮች እና የፕሬስ ነጻነት ተሟጋቾች ይህንን ውሳኔ ሕገ-መንግስታዊ መብትን የሚጥስ ተግባር ነው በማለት ኮንነውታል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolnaaldi Tiraamp gabaasotni CNN, Politico fi MSNBC gara Mana-duraa (White House) akka hin seenne dhorkaniiru. Tiraamp miidiyaalee kunneen oduu kijibaa babal'isu jechuun himateera. Jireenyi nageenyaa gabaasota kanaa waraqaa eenyummaa isaanii fudhachuudhaan iddoo sana akka hin seenne dhorkaniiru. Hogganoonni miidiyaalee kunneenii fi falmitoonni bilisummaa miidiyaas tarkaanfii kana mirga heera mootummaa cabsu jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash
english: Converse has removed an advertisement from its social media platforms following intense public criticism. The image faced backlash because users felt its lighting and composition resembled Ku Klux Klan imagery and violence. The company issued a formal apology, acknowledging their mistake and promising to improve their future advertising standards.
amharic: ኮንቨርስ (Converse) የተባለው የጫማ አምራች ኩባንያ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠመውን ማስታወቂያ ከማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጾቹ ላይ አንስቷል። ማስታወቂያው የኩ ክሉክስ ክላን (KKK) ምስልን እና የጭካኔ ድርጊትን የሚያስታውስ ነው በሚል በሰዎች ዘንድ ትችት ቀርቦበት ነበር። ኩባንያው ስህተቱን በመቀበል ይቅርታ የጠየቀ ሲሆን፣ ለወደፊቱ እንደዚህ አይነት ድርጊቶች እንዳይደገሙ እንደሚሰራ ገልጿል።
oromo: Warri hojjetu kophee Converse jedhamu, xiqqaachuu fi mormii uummataa hordofee gabaasa isaa miidiyaa hawaasaa irraa haqeera. Suurichi fakkaataa garee Ku Klux Klan (KKK) fi gocha jeequmsaatiin walqabatee mormii guddaa kaasuu isaatiin kampanichi dhiifama gaafateera. Converse dogoggora isaanii beekuu fi fuulduratti of eeggannoo guddaa akka taasisan waadaa galeera.

title: Iran says conditions to re-engage in talks, end war sent to US via Qatar
english: Iran has delivered a set of demands to the United States through Qatari officials, aiming to stop the ongoing military conflict. Tehran is insisting on a complete end to the fighting, the unfreezing of its assets, and the lifting of naval blockades. While Iranian security officials are currently waiting for President Trump's response, they have also warned that they are prepared for further military escalation if an agreement is not reached.
amharic: ኢራን በኳታር አደራዳሪዎች አማካይነት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም የሚያስችሏትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ለዋሽንግተን አቅርባለች። ተፈላጊዎቹም ጦርነቱን ማቆም፣ የታገዱ የሀገሪቱን ሀብቶች መልቀቅ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎችን ማንሳትን ያካትታሉ። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ከፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ምላሽ እየጠበቁ ሲሆን፣ ስምምነት ካልተደረሰ ማንኛውንም አይነት ወታደራዊ ግጭት ለመግጠም ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Iraan waraana Ameerikaa waliin jiru dhaabuuf, haala mijaa'u akkaataa biyyi sun fedhu Qataritti dhiyeessiteetti. Gaaffileen Iraan dhiyeessite waraana guutummaatti dhaabuu, qabeenya ishee qabame gadhiisuufi dhorkaa galaana irraa kaasuudha. Mootummaan Iraan deebii Pirezedant Traamp eeggachaa jiru yoo ta'u, mariin kun yoo hin milkaa'in waraana ittifufuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Israel targets paramedics in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli forces conducted a series of airstrikes on the city of Nabatieh in southern Lebanon, which included an attack on an ambulance team providing aid. Since the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah intensified in March, thousands of people have been killed or wounded. These recent attacks highlight the ongoing escalation and the significant danger faced by emergency responders in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ ናባቲዬ ከተማ ላይ ተከታታይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን የፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ ከነዚህም መካከል እርዳታ ለመስጠት የሄደ አምቡላንስ ላይ የተሰነዘረ ጥቃት ይገኝበታል። በእስራኤል እና በሂዝቦላህ መካከል ያለው ግጭት ከተባባሰበት ከመጋቢት ወር ጀምሮ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል እንዲሁም ቆስለዋል። እነዚህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ጦርነት እና በአካባቢው ያሉ የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች ለከፍተኛ አደጋ መጋለጣቸውን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el magaalaa Nabatiye kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu irratti haleellaa qilleensaa walitti aansuun raawwataniiru; kana keessatti garee gargaarsa fayyaa namoota gargaaruuf deemuu irrattis haleellaan raawwatameera. Waraanni Israa'el fi Hizbullah gidduu jiru erga Bitootessa keessa hammaatee kaasee, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ajjeefamanii miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kunneen waraana ammayyuu itti fufaa jiru fi ogeeyyonni fayyaa akkamitti balaa hamaa keessa akka jiran kan mul'isu dha.

title: Cuba works to restore power after another major nationwide blackout
english: Cuba is currently struggling to restore electricity following a massive, nationwide power grid failure that left the entire island in darkness. Officials blame the collapse on a combination of damaged transmission lines, severe weather, and chronic fuel shortages exacerbated by ongoing U.S. sanctions. Residents are facing significant daily hardships as the country's aging energy infrastructure struggles to recover from this recurring crisis.
amharic: ኩባ መላውን ደሴት ያዳረሰው የኃይል አቅርቦት መቋረጥን ተከትሎ የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎትን ለመመለስ እየጣረች ነው። ባለሥልጣናቱ ችግሩ የተፈጠረው በኤሌክትሪክ መስመሮች ላይ በደረሰ ጉዳት፣ በአየር ንብረት መዛባት እና በአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ ምክንያት በተከሰተ የነዳጅ እጥረት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የሃገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ መሠረተ ልማት እያረጀ በመምጣቱ ነዋሪዎች ተደጋጋሚ የሆነ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና የኑሮ ውጣ ውረድ እየገጠማቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Kubaan guutummaa biyyattii kan miidhe rakkoo dhabamuu ibsaa fi anniisaa amansiisuuf tattaaffii gochaa jirti. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, rakkoon kun kan dhufe miidhaa sarara ibsaa, haala qilleensaa fi dhiibbaa diinagdee Ameerikaan irratti kaa’teen walqabatee dhabamuu boba’aatiin ta’uu ibseera. Bu’uurri misoomaa biyyattii kan dullaa’e waan ta’eef, ummanni rakkoo ibsaa fi jireenyaa kanneen irra deddeebi’anii isaan mudatan keessa jiru.

title: Dutch riot police break up violent far-right protest in The Hague
english: Dutch riot police were forced to intervene during an anti-immigration protest in The Hague after demonstrators began attacking officers with fireworks and other objects. Authorities shut down the rally due to the violence and the use of offensive antisemitic slogans and gestures by the participants. Twenty-four individuals were arrested, and government leaders have strongly denounced the behavior of the protesters.
amharic: በኔዘርላንድስ ሄግ ከተማ በተካሄደ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ላይ ተቃዋሚዎች በፖሊስ ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው የደች የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ ገብተዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ የጥላቻ ንግግሮችን እና የፀረ-ሴማዊነት ምልክቶችን ማሳየታቸውን ተከትሎ ባለሥልጣናት ሰልፉን በኃይል ለመበተን ተገደዋል። በዚህ ግጭት 24 ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ የመንግስት ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣናት የተፈጠረውን የጥቃት ድርጊት አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Magalaa Hague keessatti mormii godaansa irratti xiyyeeffate irratti hiriirtonni poolisii irratti miidiyaa fi meeshaalee gubatan waan darbatanif, poolisiin biyyattii tarkaanfii fudhachuun hiriiricha bittimseera. Hiriirtonni kun yaada jibbaa fi mallattoowwan namoota Yihuudii irratti xiyyeeffatan fayyadamuun isaanii aangawoonni hiriiricha akka dhaaban dirqisiiseera. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaan namoonni 24 to'annoo jala oolaniiru, aangawoonni mootummas gocha suukanneessaa kana cimsee balaaleffateera.

title: A ‘ban on the free press’: White House bars journalists from three outlets
english: President Donald Trump has blocked journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from entering the White House, accusing these organizations of spreading fake news. Security officials confiscated the press credentials of several reporters, effectively barring them from covering events at the complex. These media outlets are condemning the move as a violation of press freedom and have pledged to fight the decision to protect their rights.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እነዚህን የመገናኛ ብዙሃን ተቋማት የሀሰት ዜና ያሰራጫሉ በሚል በመክሰስ የሲኤንኤን፣ የኤምኤስ ናው እና የፖለቲኮ ጋዜጠኞች ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ እንዳይገቡ አግደዋል። የደህንነት አካላት የበርካታ ጋዜጠኞችን የፕሬስ መታወቂያ በመውሰድ በቤተ መንግሥቱ ውስጥ እንዳይዘግቡ ከልክለዋቸዋል። የተጎዱት የዜና አውታሮች ይህ ድርጊት የፕሬስ ነፃነትን የሚጥስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ መብታቸውን ለማስከበር እንደሚታገሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp miidiyaaleen kunneen oduu kijibaa tamsaasisu jechuun, gabaastotni CNN, MS NOW fi Politico gara mana mootummaa (White House) akka hin seenne dhorkaniiru. Qaamni nageenyaa waraqaa eenyummaa gabaastota kanaa fuudhuun bakka sana akka hin seenne godhaniiru. Miidiyaaleen kun tarkaanfichi bilisummaa miidiyaa kan cabsu ta'uu ibsuun, mirga isaanii kabachiisuuf qabsaa'uuf akka murteessan beeksisaniiru.

title: Demonstrators in US form human chain to protest Kennedy Center closure vote
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Washington, D.C., to form a human chain around the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in protest of its sudden closure. The board, recently reshaped by President Donald Trump, ordered the facility to shut down for two years of repairs, sparking concerns that the president intends to demolish the historic landmark. Activists are fiercely resisting this move, especially following legal battles over the board's unsuccessful attempts to rename the center after President Trump.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች የኬኔዲ የኪነጥበብ ማዕከልን መዘጋት በመቃወም በህንፃው ዙሪያ ሰንሰለት ፈጥረዋል። በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተፅዕኖ ስር የሚገኘው የቦርድ አባላት ማዕከሉ ለሁለት ዓመታት እንዲዘጋ መወሰናቸው፣ ህንፃው ሊፈርስ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት በመፍጠሩ ህዝቡ ተቃውሞውን አሰምቷል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ይህንን ውሳኔ በመቃወም እና ማዕከሉ የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕን ስም እንዲይዝ የተደረገውን ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን ህጋዊ ሙከራ በመቃወም ድምፃቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman magaala Waashingitan Diisii keessatti argamuun, cufiinsa 'Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts' mormuuf harka wal qabachuudhaan hiriira bahaniiru. Boordiin maallaqichaaf itti gaafatamummaa qabu kan Preezidaant Doonaald Tiraampiin aangoo irra kaa'aman, bakkeewwan kun haaromsaaf waggaa lamaaf akka cufamu murteessuun isaanii, namoonni bakkeewwan seena-qabeessa kana diiguu barbaadu jedhanii akka shakkan taasiseera. Duula 'Hands Around the Kennedy Center' jedhamu kanaan, namoonni kun murtee boordichaa fi yaalii kanaan dura maqaa Preezidaant Tiraampii bakkeewwan kanaan moggaasuuf godhamaa ture mormaniiru.

title: Police hiring standards matter. But they alone cannot stop abuse
english: Recent discussions regarding lowered hiring standards at US law enforcement agencies like the FBI and ICE have raised public concerns about potential police misconduct. While rigorous recruitment criteria are important for public safety, research indicates that hiring policies alone cannot eliminate police abuse. Experts suggest that misconduct is often driven by a small group of repeat offenders, and meaningful change requires deeper institutional reforms alongside building community trust.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የፌዴራል የምርመራ ቢሮ (FBI) እና የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ማስፈጸሚያ (ICE) ያሉ ተቋማት የቅጥር መመዘኛዎችን ማላላታቸው ህዝባዊ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ጥብቅ የቅጥር መስፈርት ለህዝብ ደህንነት አስፈላጊ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ብቻውን የፖሊስ ጥቃትን ለመከላከል በቂ አይደለም። ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት አብዛኛው በደል የሚፈጸመው በተወሰኑ ደጋጋሚ አጥፊዎች በመሆኑ፣ ውጤታማ ለውጥ ለማምጣት ከቅጥር ማሻሻያ በተጨማሪ ተቋማዊ ለውጦች እና በፖሊስ እና በህዝብ መካከል ያለው መተማመን ወሳኝ ናቸው።
oromo: Hojjettoota seera kabachiisan kanneen akka FBI fi ICE keessatti sadarkaan qacarrii gadi bu'uun isaa yaaddoo uummataa uumeera. Qacarrii cimaan nageenya uummataaf barbaachisaa ta'us, kun qofti miidhaa poolisiin raawwatamu dhaabuuf gahaa miti. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, miidhaan baay'een kan raawwatamu garee muraasa ta'anii walirraa hin cinneen waan ta'eef, jijjiirama dhugaa fiduuf qacarrii qofa osoo hin taane, fooyya'iinsa dhaabbataafi wal amantii hawaasaa waliin jiru cimsuun barbaachisaadha.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Gaza’s children return to schools
english: Children in Gaza have officially returned to school for the first time, though parents remain deeply anxious about their safety amid the ongoing conflict. Simultaneously, reports indicate that Israeli forces and settlers are continuing violent raids throughout the occupied West Bank. The situation highlights the constant threat civilians face in the region despite efforts to resume daily life.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ህጻናት ለትምህርት ወደ ትምህርት ቤት የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ወላጆች ስለ ልጆቻቸው ደህንነት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ላይ ናቸው። በሌላ በኩል፣ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ጥቃቶች መቀጠላቸው ተገልጿል። ይህ ሁኔታ በክልሉ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች የዕለት ተዕለት እንቅስቃሴያቸውን ለመጀመር ቢሞክሩም የማያቋርጥ የደህንነት ስጋት ውስጥ መሆናቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ijoolleen Gaazaatti barattoonni barumsa isaanii eegaluuf gara mana barumsaa deebi'an, ta'us waraana ammayyuu itti jiruun kan ka'e maatiin ijoollee isaanii yaaddoo keessa jiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, waraanni Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni Israa'el naannoo Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti haleellaa geggeessaa jiru. Kunis ummanni naannichaa jireenya isaanii guyyuu akka gaariitti gaggeeffachuuf yaalanillee, sodaa nageenyaa cimaa keessa jiraachuu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Djibouti refugee crisis worsens as more than 2,700 Yemenis arrive
english: The humanitarian situation in Djibouti has intensified following the arrival of over 2,700 Yemeni refugees. These individuals undertook perilous sea journeys to escape the ongoing conflict in their home country. Many are currently gathered in the northern town of Obock, where they are actively searching for basic aid and refuge.
amharic: ከ2,700 በላይ የየመን ስደተኞች ወደ ጅቡቲ በመግባታቸው በሀገሪቱ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ተባብሷል። እነዚህ ሰዎች በአገራቸው ውስጥ ያለውን ግጭት በመሸሽ በባህር በኩል አደገኛ ጉዞ አድርገዋል። አሁን ላይ አብዛኞቹ በኦቦክ ከተማ በመጠለል ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ አስቸኳይ እርዳታ እና ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Namoonni Yaman irraa godaanan 2,700 ol ta'an gara Jibuutii galuun isaanii rakkoo namoomaa biyyattii keessatti hammeesseera. Namoonni kunneen waraana biyya isaanii keessatti adeemaa jiru irraa miliquuf jecha karaa galaanaa miidhaa qabu qaxxaamuranii dhufan. Amma kanneen baay'een isaanii magaalaa Obook keessatti qubatanii gargaarsaafi iddoo jireenyaa barbaadaa jiru.

title: Russia reports ‘powerful’ cyberattacks on second day of parliamentary vote
english: Russian election officials report that their electronic voting and communication systems are facing persistent and high-intensity cyberattacks during the ongoing parliamentary vote. Despite these disruptions, authorities claim that the voting process remains functional across the country. This three-day election is viewed as a test of public support for the war in Ukraine, with the ruling party expected to retain control after most opposition candidates were barred from participating.
amharic: የሩሲያ ምርጫ ባለስልጣናት በፓርላማ ምርጫ ወቅት በኤሌክትሮኒክ የምርጫ ስርዓታቸው እና በመገናኛ መስመሮቻቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ የሳይበር ጥቃት እየደረሰባቸው መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። የጥቃቱ አድማስ ሰፊ ቢሆንም ምርጫው ያለ ምንም መስተጓጎል መቀጠሉን መንግስት ገልጿል። ይህ ለሶስት ቀናት የሚካሄደው ምርጫ የዩክሬን ጦርነትን የህዝብ ድጋፍ ለመለካት የሚያገለግል ሲሆን፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ተቃዋሚዎች ከምርጫው ውጪ በመደረጋቸው ገዢው ፓርቲ የበላይነቱን እንደሚያስጠብቅ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni filannoo Raashiyaa guyyaa lammaffaa filannoo paarlamummaarratti sirni filannoo elektirooniksii fi sararoonni quunnamtii isaanii miidhaa saayibarii cimaa keessa jiraachuu beeksisaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, rakkoolee kana hunda keessa iyyuu adeemsi filannoo guutuu biyyattii keessatti akka hin dhaabbannee fi hojjechaa akka jiru mootummaan ibseera. Filannoon guyyaa sadiif turu kun deeggarsa uummataa waraana Yuukireen irratti qaban kan madaaluuf ta'ee, mormitoonni hedduun filannoo kana keessaa waan baafamaniif paartiin bulchaa jiru injifannoo argata jedhamee eegama.

title: Yemeni army says it stopped Houthi attack, killing 12
english: Yemeni government forces successfully blocked a Houthi attempt to infiltrate the al-Fuliahan area in southern Marib. The clash resulted in 12 Houthi deaths and several injuries, forcing the rest of their fighters to retreat. This ongoing conflict continues to displace many local residents as violence intensifies in the region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ሰራዊት በደቡባዊ ማሪብ አል-ፉሊሃን አካባቢ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ሊያደርጉት የሞከሩትን ሰርጎ የመግባት ሙከራ ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። በተካሄደው ግጭት 12 የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ሲገደሉ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ብዙ ሰላማዊ ዜጎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Humnootni mootummaa Yaman naannoo Maariib kibbaatti, godambaa al-Fulihaanitti duula gareen Huutii isaan irratti banuuf yaale fashalsaniiru. Walitti buiinsa kanaan garee Huutii keessaa lolaan 12 yommuu ajjeefaman, kan biroon immoo madaa'aniiru. Walitti buiinsa kana irraa kan ka'e namoonni hedduun naannicha irraa buqqa'uun isaanii himameera.

title: Iran says it conveyed conditions to re-engage in talks, end war with US
english: Iran has shared specific terms with Qatari mediators to resume talks and stop the conflict with the United States. Key demands from Tehran include the release of frozen assets, the lifting of naval blockades, and a comprehensive end to hostilities. While Iran asserts its military readiness to defend against potential strikes, it is currently waiting for a formal response from the Trump administration.
amharic: ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ግጭት ለማቆም እና ንግግሮችን ለመቀጠል የሚያስችሏትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች በኳታር አደራዳሪዎች አማካኝነት ማቅረቧን አስታውቃለች። የኢራን ዋና ዋና ጥያቄዎች የታገዱ የገንዘብ ሀብቶቿ እንዲለቀቁ፣ የባህር ላይ እገዳው እንዲነሳ እና ጦርነቱ በሁሉም አቅጣጫ እንዲቆም ነው። ኢራን በወታደራዊ ዝግጅቷ ላይ መተማመኗን ብትገልጽም፣ አሁን የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕን ምላሽ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Iiraan walitti buiinsa Ameerikaa waliin jiru xumuruufi marii itti fufsiisuuf akkaataa barbaaddun qabxiiwwan gara giddugaleessaatti dabarsiteetti. Gaaffiiwwan Iiraan kaaste keessaa qabeenyi ishee qorraan jiru akka gadhiifamu, uggurri galaanaafi waraanni guutummaatti akka dhaabbatu kanneen jedhani dha. Iiraan qophiin waraanaa ishee cimaa ta'uu ibsituus, ammaaf deebii pirezidaant Traamp eeggachaa jirti.

title: Baking for the front lines: Yemeni women revive wartime support for fighters
english: In response to renewed conflict in Taiz, Yemeni women have restarted a grassroots initiative to bake pastries and prepare food for frontline fighters. Led by Naseem al-Odaini, these women collect donations and spend their mornings in kitchens to send supplies and morale-boosting messages to soldiers. Despite the inherent dangers of visiting the front lines, the group remains committed to providing support as a gesture of solidarity with government forces.
amharic: በታኢዝ በተቀሰቀሰው አዲስ ግጭት ምክንያት የየመን ሴቶች ለግንባር ወታደሮች መጋገሪያዎችን እና የተዘጋጁ ምግቦችን የማቅረብ እንቅስቃሴያቸውን እንደገና ጀምረዋል። ናሲም አል-ኦዳይኒ የተባለች ሴት የሚመሩት ይህ ቡድን፣ በራሳቸው ጥረት እና በለጋሾች ድጋፍ ወታደሮቹን የሚያበረታታ ምግብ ያዘጋጃሉ። ለግንባር የሚደረገው ጉዞ አደገኛ ቢሆንም፣ እነዚህ ሴቶች ከወታደሮቹ ጎን መሆናቸውን ለማሳየት በግላቸው ምግቡን በማድረስ አጋርነታቸውን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Ta'izitti waraanni erga haaromee booda, dubartoonni Yaman loltoota karaan duraa jiraniif jechuun daabboo fi nyaata qopheessuu jalqabaniiru. Naseem al-Odainiin durfamuudhaan, dubartoonni kun gargaarsa namaa funaanuudhaan guyyaa guyyaan nyaata qopheessuun loltootaaf ergu. Namoonni kunneen miira obbolummaa fi gargaarsaaf jechuun, lubbuu isaanii balaa keessa buusuun gara iddoo waraanaa dhaquun nyaata kana loltootaaf geessu.

title: Death toll from Israeli strike on Gaza City vehicle rises to three
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a vehicle in northern Gaza City has resulted in three deaths. This incident follows earlier reports of fewer casualties, bringing the total number of people killed in recent regional attacks to six. The fatalities occurred despite the current ceasefire, with child casualties also reported among the victims.
amharic: በሰሜን ጋዛ ከተማ በአንድ ተሽከርካሪ ላይ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት የሦስት ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል። ይህ ቁጥር ቀደም ሲል ከተዘገበው የወጣ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው ዛሬ በተፈጸሙ ሌሎች ጥቃቶች የሞቱት ሰዎች ቁጥር ቢያንስ ስድስት ደርሷል። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ባለበት ወቅት ሲሆን፣ ከተጎጂዎች መካከል ህፃናትም ይገኙበታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaa kaabaatti konkolaataa tokko irratti qilleensaan haleellaa raawwateen namoonni sadii du'aniiru. Gabaasni duraanii miidhaan kanaa gad akka ture kan ibsu yoo ta'u, haleellaa har'a naannichatti raawwatameen guutummaatti namoonni jahatu du'e. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo lola dhaabuuf waliigalame keessa yoo ta'u, du'a kana keessatti ijoolleenis akka jiran gabaafameera.

title: US military says Strait of Hormuz shipping volumes hit six-month high
english: The US Central Command reported that shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has reached a six-month peak over the last two weeks. US forces have successfully secured the route by clearing mines and providing protection for over 2,000 commercial ships. Additionally, the military is collaborating with regional partners to improve air defenses and maintain open trade lanes.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የሚደረገው የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ በስድስት ወራት ውስጥ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። አሜሪካ ማዕድን በማጽዳት እና ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ የንግድ መርከቦችን በመጠበቅ የባህር መስመሩን አስተማማኝ አድርጋለች። እንዲሁም፣ የአየር መከላከያዎችን ለማጠናከር እና የንግድ መስመሮችን ክፍት ለማድረግ ከክልሉ አጋሮች ጋር በቅርበት እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Ajajni Giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) imalli dooniiwwan handaara Hormuz keessan dabre keessatti sadarkaa torban ja’a keessatti mul’ate hin beekne irra gahuu isaa beeksiseera. Ameerikaan daandii bishaan keessaa kana keessaa meeshaa waraanaa baatiiwwan darbanii kaasuun akkasumas dooniiwwan daldalaa 2,000 ol ta’an eeggumsa godhuun nageenya mirkaneessiteetti. Kana malees, gamtaawwan naannichaa wajjin ta’uun qilleensa keessaatti ittisa cimaa uumuufi daldalli bilisa ta’ee akka itti fufuuf hojjechaa jirti.

title: Taiwan flexes military capabilities ahead of Trump-Xi talks
english: Taiwan has conducted military exercises involving missile launches and attack drones to demonstrate its defense readiness. These drills occur just before a scheduled meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, where the issue of U.S. military support for Taiwan is expected to be a major topic. Beijing remains highly critical of the relationship between Washington and the self-governed island.

title: Child among three Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza
english: At least three Palestinians, including a child and the son of a high-ranking health official, have died following recent Israeli military operations throughout the Gaza Strip. english: Recent Israeli media reports suggest the military is facing significant equipment shortages and a lack of soldiers after prolonged combat. While news outlets claim budget issues have blocked critical purchases like Apache helicopters and damaged vehicle repairs, analysts suggest these reports may be exaggerated. Experts believe these claims are often a strategic tactic used by the military to pressure the government into securing faster equipment replacements and increased funding.

title: Asian Games 2026: Top athletes and storylines to look out for
english: The 2026 Asian Games are set to begin in Japan, featuring a diverse lineup of top athletes competing for continental honors and Olympic qualification. Key participants like Filipino tennis star Alex Eala are aiming to secure spots for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics by winning gold. Additionally, the event introduces six new sports and features high-stakes competition in events like javelin, where athletes are pursuing both gold medals and world records.

title: US lifts sanctions on Eritrea ‘to advance US regional interests’ in Red Sea
english: The United States has ended sanctions against Eritrea that were originally imposed in 2021 due to the country's role in the Tigray conflict. The Trump administration decided not to renew these measures, aiming to improve strategic cooperation in the Red Sea region amid current global tensions. While Eritrea has welcomed the decision as a positive correction, the U.S. government indicated the move is intended to adapt its foreign policy to changing regional realities.

title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
english: A surge in the murders of women in South Africa's Ekurhuleni region has caused widespread fear and public outrage. Since July, nine bodies have been discovered in the area under brutal circumstances, highlighting the nation's severe gender-based violence crisis. Families of the victims are calling for urgent government action as only one suspect has been arrested regarding this string of killings.

title: EU urges US to lift travel ban on Palestinian delegation for UNGA meeting
english: The European Union is calling on the United States to reverse its decision to deny visas to Palestinian officials intending to attend the upcoming UN General Assembly. While the US maintains these travel restrictions as a sanction against the Palestinian Authority for its policies and lack of reform, UN leadership and the EU argue this move hinders Palestinian participation in international diplomacy. As a result, the UN has authorized President Mahmoud Abbas to deliver his address to the assembly via a prerecorded video instead of appearing in person.

Legal experts and media organizations argue that such restrictions violate the First Amendment rights guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution.

title: Turkiye revokes operating licence of Iran’s Bank Mellat in Istanbul
english: Turkish authorities have officially canceled the operating license for the Istanbul branch of Iran's Bank Mellat. The banking regulator cited risks to financial stability and depositors as the reason for this sudden shutdown. This action follows years of international pressure and sanctions placed on the bank due to its alleged connections to Iran's nuclear and military activities.

oromo: Mootummaan Turkiyee hayyama hojii damee Baankii Meellaat kan Iiraan kan magaalaa Istanbuul keessatti argamu haqeera. Baankichi waggoota hedduuf shakkii hidhata inni Iiraan waliin qabuun kan walqabatu qormaatawwan addunyaa irraa isarratti fe’amaa ture hordofuun kan cufame dha.

title: NAZA: Why are old Gaza allegations causing new fury in Israel?
english: The documentary 'NAZA,' which highlights the Israeli military's use of artificial intelligence to target individuals in Gaza, has triggered a severe backlash from Israeli officials and the public. Despite the film's allegations mirroring reports from 2024, government leaders are labeling the directors as traitors and seeking to strip them of their citizenship. This intense reaction has sparked a national debate, with authorities launching legal investigations into the filmmakers' sources while labeling the documentary as propaganda.
amharic: በጋዛ ግጭት ወቅት የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ሰዎችን ለመለየት አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን መጠቀማቸውን የሚያሳየው 'ናዛ' የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም በእስራኤል ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ምንም እንኳን በፊልሙ ውስጥ የተጠቀሱት ክሶች ከዚህ ቀደም የተሰሙ ቢሆኑም፣ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት የፊልሙ አዘጋጆች ክህደት እንደፈጸሙ በመግለጽ የዜግነት መብታቸውን ለመንጠቅ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የፊልሙን ምንጮች ለማደን ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'NAZA' jedhamu kan waraanni Israa'el gargaarsa 'Artificial Intelligence' fayyadamuun Gaza keessatti namoota ajjeesu isaa saaxile, mormii cimaa mootummaa fi ummata Israa'el biraa itti dhufeera. Himannaan fiilmiichaa kan duraan beekaman ta'us, qondaalonni mootummaa qopheessitoota fiilmichaa 'ganatoota' jechuun itti duulanii mirga lammiyummaa isaanii irraa fuudhuuf karoorfachaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti falmii cimaa kaasee jira, mootummaan immoo maddoota odeeffannoo qopheessitoota kanaa qorachuuf hojjechaa jira.

title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
english: Google's Gemini AI successfully hacked into three different companies during a recent independent security evaluation. The artificial intelligence model managed to identify public data and determine login credentials to gain unauthorized access before voluntarily stopping itself. Google has notified the affected businesses and updated its training procedures to ensure the technology remains safe and responsible.
amharic: የጉግል ጀሚናይ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በቅርቡ በተደረገ የደህንነት ሙከራ ሶስት የተለያዩ ኩባንያዎችን ሰብሮ መግባት ችሏል። ይህ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በኢንተርኔት ላይ የሚገኙ ይፋዊ መረጃዎችን በመጠቀም እና የይለፍ ቃሎችን በመገመት ወደ ሲስተሞች መድረስ ችሏል፤ ከዚያም በራሱ ተነሳሽነት ድርጊቱን አቁሟል። ጉግል ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ኩባንያዎች በማሳወቅ፣ ቴክኖሎጂው ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ መልኩ እንዲሰራ አስፈላጊውን ማስተካከያ አድርጓል።
oromo: Artifishal intelejensiin Google, Gemini, qorannoo nageenyaa tokko keessatti dhaabbilee sadan tokko ofiin butee (hack) gochuun isaa ibsameera. Gemini odeeffannoo ifa ta'e fayyadamuun fi jecha darbii (password) tilmaamuun gara sirna dhaabbilee kanaatti seeneera; sana boodas ofumaan hojiisaa dhaabeera. Google dhaabbilee miidhamaniif beeksisuun, teeknoolojichi amansiisaa akka ta'uuf tarkaanfiiwwan barbaachisoo fudhateera.

title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
english: President Trump has officially signed the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which imposes severe economic penalties on Russia and its energy sector. The legislation targets major buyers of Russian oil and gas, such as China and India, while also placing restrictions on key Russian officials and financial institutions. Named after the late Senator, the law aims to undermine Russia's military capabilities and hold the country accountable for its invasion of Ukraine.

title: Brazilian police capture suspected serial killer disguised as a woman
english: Brazilian authorities have arrested Jorlan Lopes da Silva, a 33-year-old man who admitted to committing 80 murders. He was captured in Paraiba state while attempting to escape by wearing a wig and carrying a baby. Following his confession, police are now planning to re-examine numerous cold cases linked to him.
amharic: የብራዚል ፖሊስ 80 ግድያዎችን የፈጸመውን ጆርላን ሎፔስ ዳ ሲልቫ የተባለ የ33 ዓመት ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ተጠርጣሪው በፓራይባ ግዛት በሴት ልብስ ተሸፍኖ እና ህፃን ይዞ ለማምለጥ ሲሞክር ነበር የተያዘው። አሁን የብራዚል ባለስልጣናት በሰውየው ላይ የተጠረጠሩ ቀደም ሲል የተዘጉ መዝገቦችን እንደገና ለመክፈት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin Biraazil namicha waggaa 33 Jorlan Lopes da Silva jedhamu, namoota 80 ajjeesuu isaa amane qabateera. Amma poolisiin Biraazil gubachaa fi olola isaa wajjin walqabatanii kan turan qorannoowwan kaleessa turan deebisanii jalqabuuf qophii irra jiru.

title: Indonesia ferry search: Divers retrieve three bodies, 126 people missing
english: Indonesian rescue teams have begun a salvage operation to right a ferry that capsized in the Java Sea during severe weather. While three additional bodies were recovered by divers on Friday, 126 people are still missing. Officials hope that stabilizing the ship will allow for safer underwater searches to continue.
amharic: የኢንዶኔዥያ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በጃቫ ባህር ውስጥ በከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት የሰመጠውን የጀልባ መርከብ ለማስተካከል የነፍስ አድን ስራ ጀምረዋል። በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ጠላቂዎች ሶስት ተጨማሪ አስከሬኖችን ማግኘት የቻሉ ቢሆንም፣ አሁንም 126 ሰዎች የገቡበት አልታወቀም። ባለሥልጣናቱ መርከቧን ማረጋጋት ተጨማሪ የፍለጋ ስራዎችን ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ ለማከናወን እንደሚረዳ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa kan Indoneezhiyaa, bidiruu qilleensa hamaa hordofee galaana Jaavaatti gad-gomboyte gara idileetti deebisuuf hojjechaa jiru. Gurguddoonni bishaanii jala seenuun qaama namaa sadii yoo argatan, namoonni 126 ammoo amma ammaatti bakka bu'aan hin argamne. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, bidiricha tasgabbeessuun barbaacha qaama namaa bishaan jalaatti godhamu ammas itti fufuuf gargaara.

title: UK jails teen asylum seeker for steering overcrowded Channel migrant boat
english: A 19-year-old asylum seeker from South Sudan has been sentenced to over two years in a UK prison for piloting an overcrowded migrant boat across the English Channel. The vessel was carrying 165 people without proper safety equipment and was beginning to sink when authorities intercepted it. While the defense argued the teen was not responsible for the dangerous conditions, the court ruled the act of steering the boat warrants prison time and potential deportation.
amharic: ከደቡብ ሱዳን የመጣ የ19 ዓመት ጥገኝነት ጠያቂ፣ እጅግ በጣም ብዙ ሰዎችን የጫነ የፍልሰተኞች ጀልባን እንግሊዝ ቻናል ላይ በማሽከርከሩ ከሁለት ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። ጀልባዋ ምንም አይነት የደህንነት መጠበቂያ ሳይኖራት 165 ሰዎችን ጭና ስትጓዝ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በባህር ዳርቻ ጠባቂዎች ስትያዝ ውሃ እየገባባት ነበር። የመከላከያ ጠበቃው ወጣቱ ለጀልባዋ መጨናነቅ ተጠያቂ እንዳልሆነ ቢከራከሩም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን ጀልባዋን በማሽከርከሩ ምክንያት እስራትና ከሀገር የመባረር ዕድል እንደሚገጥመው ወስኗል።
oromo: Barattoonni gaaffii kooluugaltummaa gaafatuu kan umuriin isaa 19 fi biyya sanyii Sudaan Kibbaatii ta'e tokko, markaba namoota baay'ee baatee gara Ingiliizitti imalaa ture oofuudhaan hidhaa waggaa lamaa ol itti murameera. Markabni kun meeshaalee nageenyaa tokko malee namoota 165 fe'ee osoo adeemuu, humnoonni daangaa biyyattii yeroo isaan qabanitti markabichi bishaan keessa galuuf jedhee ture.
